subject: I got a package in running

messages.author: 91c5aa8bf89b097c
messages.subject: I got a package in running
parts:
Hello

I was running tsDyn package, but I got the followng error. I was wondering if you know how I can fix it?

Error in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]) :
namespace ‘Rcpp’ 0.12.1 is already loaded, but >= 0.12.3 is required
In addition: Warning message:
package ‘tsDyn’ was built under R version 3.2.5
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘tsDyn’


Regards
Omid

messages.author: 8c45483022d450d5
messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] I got a package in running
parts:
Hi Omid

It is difficult to see where the issue is, in particular it does not seem directly related to tsDyn. Did you try updating Rcpp to the newest version? If it still fails with that new version, please try to find which sequence of package loading triggers the error.

Best,

Matthieu
